# Phillips.

> Phillips. is the marketing consultancy of Lewis Phillips, a marketing consultant based in Ely, Cambridgeshire, UK. He helps small businesses in Ely and Cambridgeshire get found, win customers, know what works, run on systems and grow the team, either instead of a marketing hire or alongside an existing team. Larger and international companies use him for senior paid media consultancy.

Key facts:

- Based in Ely, Cambridgeshire. Works with businesses in Ely, Soham, Littleport, Cambridge, Newmarket and the villages between, and across Cambridgeshire. Consultancy for larger companies is not limited by area.
- One person, Lewis Phillips: a consultant, not an agency.
- 11 years in marketing. Founder of The Pommier (self-taught, self-funded; grew a Shopify website into £900k a year in sales with two retail outlets in central London). Built the websites and long-tail SEO for Lee Renée and Myia Bonner. Scaled UK paid media into eight figures a year at MyBuilder (later Angi), then ran 8 international markets. Now works on global attraction booking at Go City.
- Strengths: strategic thinker (has solved problems for big companies, small businesses and his own businesses), optimiser (looks at the full picture, then the detail), systems builder (builds the tracking, reporting and tools, and writes the code).
- Prices: websites start at £995, including a customer tool, with technical maintenance and security at £45 a month. Google Ads management starts at £500 a month and is based on the hours the account needs at Lewis's hourly rate; clients pay Google separately for ads. Ongoing SEO (technical SEO first) also starts at £500 a month, based on the hours the site needs. The free Google Ads Check shows the monthly fee for a given account. Other work is priced in writing before it starts.
- Contact: the "Ask me a question" form at https://www.phillips-uk.com/#contact (also on Work, About and every service page). Lewis replies by email.
- Phillips. is a trading name of PHILLIPSGROUPUK LIMITED (company number 17567515), part of the Phillips Group of Companies.

## Services

- [Web design](https://www.phillips-uk.com/web-design/): Websites for small businesses in Ely and Cambridgeshire: fast, built for phones first and made to turn visits into enquiries, with tracking from day one.
- [Local SEO and AI search](https://www.phillips-uk.com/local-seo/): Local SEO for Ely and Cambridgeshire businesses, built for Google and AI answers: Business Profile, pages that answer real questions, listings, reviews.
- [Google Ads](https://www.phillips-uk.com/google-ads/): Google Ads management for Ely and Cambridgeshire businesses: set up or rebuilt, tracked properly and judged on enquiries and sales.
- [Marketing systems](https://www.phillips-uk.com/marketing-systems/): GA4 and Tag Manager tracking, enquiry handling and CRM, automation and dashboards.
- [Consultancy](https://www.phillips-uk.com/consultancy/): Senior marketing services for larger companies: an audit and plan, a senior lead without a full-time hire, or support for an in-house team.

## Free tools

Lewis gives these away with nothing asked in return, and builds the same kind of free tool (calculators, quote builders, checkers) into clients' websites: https://www.phillips-uk.com/marketing-systems/#tools

- [Free checks](https://www.phillips-uk.com/free-checks/): both free checks on one page, with Search Desk, the daily Google Ads dashboard Lewis built.
- [Google Ads Check](https://www.phillips-uk.com/google-ads-audit): a free, read-only Google Ads audit (Google Ads account check, PPC audit tool), for small and medium businesses. You invite the Phillips. manager account read only from inside Google Ads; it reads conversion tracking (including possible double counting), settings, search terms, keywords, ads, bidding, Shopping and Performance Max, checks that the most used landing pages load, summarises the changes Google Ads reports for the last 28 days and shows up to 13 months of results. The report opens with a short written summary and a ranked list of fixes, optionally judged against the visitor's own target cost per conversion or return on ad spend, then removes the manager link. Fixed written rules, no AI: every figure is calculated from the account, and no account data goes to an AI company. One free check per account every 30 days.
- [Website Check](https://www.phillips-uk.com/website-check/): a free website audit (website checker) for any UK business website, one public page at a time, no sign-in, up to five checks a day. Speed and Core Web Vitals from Google PageSpeed Insights, phone layout, contact details, page titles and LocalBusiness structured data, https, robots.txt and sitemap, AI crawler access and llms.txt, enquiry tracking and reviews. Fixed written rules, no AI.

## The Monday Brief

- [The Monday Brief](https://www.phillips-uk.com/updates/): a weekly email and web page, every Monday at 7am UK time, on what changed in Google Ads, GA4, SEO, Merchant Center, Microsoft Ads, Meta, Apple Ads and LinkedIn Ads, and what each change could affect in an account. Every item links to the platform's own announcement. Free, with double opt-in sign-up.
